paragraphs.text: The Hightrunk Chamber was the royal court and seat of power of the Elven Empire of Havenwood on Sarpadia .

The ruling council, headed by a king, used the court as a meeting place. Morgan , a Thelonite Druid , an advisor, and Loren , a master scout, both held sway at court, though their goals and means differed. The council leader and elder druid was named Kolevi .
